record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: INCINEROAR, LITTEN and TORRACAT (the queued units; none has a passive in the catalog). The strategy is shared; the units differ in stars and stats only.
record.summary: Single-target multi-hit SPECIAL damage: the target is flinched for 1000 ms, and round((1 + 0.01 x speed) x 3) hits (speed read at cast time) are queued over about one second, each dealing 1 x the caster's ATK (read at that hit) at 1-3 stars (2 x at 4 stars). Fire-synergy effects add attack to the caster after each hit. The caster then moves to the empty cell closest to the point behind the target, if there is one.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target); every queued hit goes to that same target
targeting.note: hits are skipped once the target's hp is 0; there is no range, position or retargeting check at hit time.

geometry.shape: single target; displacement of the caster to the empty cell nearest (target position + (target - caster))
geometry.destination: Board.getClosestAvailablePlace of the point one step past the target in the caster -> target direction (the point may lie off the board; only empty cells are candidates; ties keep the sorted order of board.forEach, not traced)

declaredRaw.base: the caster's atk at the moment of each hit
declaredRaw.hits: round((1 + 0.01 x speed) x 3), speed at cast time
declaredRaw.spacing: hit i delayed round(i x 1000 / hits) ms

effects.scaling: requested amount per hit: multiplier x atk (atk includes whatever the entity has at that moment, e.g. earlier attack gains from this cast, items per core-mechanics section I); then AP: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); the cast's single crit flag multiplies every hit if it is true (needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: applied amount per hit: the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later handleDamage modifiers; blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce. No hit is dealt once the target is dead. takenDamage is not used by this ability.

declaredRaw.note: flat attack added after each damaging hit; first matching effect only

effects.scaling: requested amount: addAttack(value, caster = self, apBoost 0, crit false), so neither AP nor crit scales it
effects.resolution: applied amount: applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff multiplies a positive value by 1.25 (rounded down, 0 digits) if the caster holds BIG_EATER_BELT; applyTwistBandBuff affects only negative values, so it does nothing here; atk = max(1, atk + value); not permanent. The gain raises atk for the NEXT hit(s) of this cast and for the basic attacks afterwards.

declaredRaw.destination: closest empty cell to the point behind the target

effects.resolution: if a cell exists: moveTo(..., false) (forcedDisplacement false, canBeMoved not consulted) then resetCooldown(500), i.e. cooldown = round(500 / (0.4 + speed x 0.007)) with the caster's current speed, replacing the cooldown of 100 that moveTo sets. If no empty cell exists the caster stays and the cooldown is not reset.

statusEffects.applicationOrder: at cast time, before any hit and independent of whether damage is dealt
statusEffects.guards: not applied if runeProtect; duration passes through applyStatusDurationReductions; a new flinch replaces the remaining time only if longer
statusEffects.combatEffect: while flinched, damage that would hit a shield is split: half is dealt to the shield and half is residual damage to HP (the only use of status.flinch read in app/core and app/models besides status.ts; other directories not searched).

starBehavior.note: multiplier indexed by the casting entity's stars: 1 for 1-3 stars, 2 only at 4 stars (and the fallback); the 4-star value is not reached by these units' bare star counts (1, 2, 3). maxPP is 80 and range 1 for all three. Catalog base speed is 44 for all three, which gives round(1.44 x 3) = 4 hits at base speed; actual speed at cast time may differ (items, buffs).

record.positionalConditions: The caster needs the target in range to cast (requiresTarget true). Hits do not check range or position, so they still land after the caster has moved behind the target. The move needs at least one empty cell on the board.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state and no modes. Queued hits are entries in the caster's commands list, each tied to the cast's target and crit flag; a later cast adds its own set. Permanent effects: none (the attack gains are not permanent).
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw): damage per hit = 1 x atk (4-star: 2 x atk) at hit time, number of hits round((1 + 0.01 x speed) x 3), flinch 1000 ms, attack gain +1/+2/+3 per hit under WILDFIRE/BLAZE/DESOLATE_LAND. Applied: damage after AP/crit, then SPE_DEF division (ceil, min 1) and later handleDamage modifiers; attack gain after the Big Eater Belt helper (x1.25 rounded down) and the atk floor of 1; flinch after status duration reductions; cooldown reset per resetCooldown with the caster's speed.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read
Whether the caster's pending commands keep running when the caster dies, is frozen, asleep or otherwise not updated normally (PokemonState.updateCommands was read, not every state that skips update)
How the caster's atk and speed are built from items, synergies and buffs before the cast (core-mechanics section I covers declared item bonuses)
Crit resolution (only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read)
unresolved: Board.forEach iteration order, which decides ties between equally distant empty cells
Whether hits of a cast still happen if the caster dies before they are due (commands live on the caster entity; not traced)
Whether any other item or synergy effect changes the ability beyond what is listed
Whether the sourceTables pattern's multiplier table is the only star-scaled number: the hit count is a speed formula, not a star table
Gameplay behaviour is not tested; this is source reading with mechanical checks only
